sentence_stem: The new café is much bigger than the old one, so
correct_completion: it has more tables for customers.
full_sentence: The new café is much bigger than the old one, so it has more tables for customers.
acceptable_variants: it can serve more people at once.
there is more space for everyone to sit.

options.text: it is much smaller than before.
options.why_wrong: This contradicts the first part of the sentence, which says the new café is bigger, not smaller.
This does not follow from the size comparison, so it does not complete the cause-and-effect meaning.

options.text: it has more tables for customers.
the old one was closed last year.
options.why_wrong: This gives a fact about the old café, but it does not explain a result of the new café being bigger.

grammar_focus: Comparative adjectives (bigger than) with the cause-and-effect connector 'so'
explanation: After 'so', we need a clause that states the result of the comparison in the stem. Learners should check that the completion follows logically from the size of the new café.
translation: Yeni kafe eskisinden çok daha büyük olduğu için müşterilere ayrılmış daha fazla masası var.
